checkpoints.title: Phase 0 Audit & NOAA Solar Ephemeris Engine
checkpoints.summary: Replaced hardcoded prototype sun angles with Spencer/Meeus NOAA solar ephemeris algorithm. Verified elevation, azimuth, and clear-sky lux model across 9 test cases including Equator equinox, London solstice, Sydney winter noon, and Tromsø polar extremes.

checkpoints.title: Diffuse Cognitive Engine & Physical Safety Engineering
checkpoints.summary: Engineered deterministic break missions for all 4 cognitive blockers (Complex Bug, Merge Conflict, Memory Leak, Deploy Burnout) and 3 duration tiers (15, 20, 30 min). Enforced strict physical safety: azimuth is an astronomical reference, not a walking route; direct sun gazing is explicitly forbidden; night missions adapt optical tasks to distant skyline/stars.

checkpoints.title: Web Speech/Audio Acoustic Briefing & 1080p Canvas Exporter
checkpoints.summary: Implemented zero-latency browser-native speech synthesis with queue cancellation and 432Hz ambient harmonic drone. Built client-side HTML5 canvas wallpaper generator rendering 1080x1920 mobile PNGs with live mission parameters, return deadlines, and high-contrast dark aesthetic.

checkpoints.title: Offline Service Worker & Static GitHub Pages Export
checkpoints.summary: Built scope-relative service worker caching shell and static assets under both root and GitHub Pages /breakpoint base path. Added asset-path resolver preventing broken images in subpath environments.

checkpoints.title: Automated Unit Test Suite & Visual Regression Validation
checkpoints.summary: Verified 18 automated unit tests passing across ephemeris math, cognitive generation, and store persistence. Conducted multi-viewport visual checks confirming exact adherence to the approved 4-panel visual design.
